findings.claim: Frozen P0 inventories are internally deduplicated: 38 callers, 21 triggers and 6 external entries, all distinct under their observed keys.
All 38 frozen caller names currently resolve.
A bounded current name-pattern scan returns 75 candidates: 27 overlap P0, 48 are outside P0, while 11 P0 callers fall outside the pattern.
All 21 frozen trigger names currently resolve with matching enabled-state text.
Pre-cut readiness rows contain 42 distinct pantalla_id values and family_count is consistently 47; this raw denominator is not automatically identical to the governed receipt cohort.

assumptions.text: Frozen P0 completeness is completeness of the frozen inventory, not proof of current closed-world completeness.
Name-pattern membership is only a discovery heuristic and may both miss valid P0 callers and include non-runtime objects.
Raw pre-cut screens/family_count do not reproduce the governed receipt inclusion predicate.
Trigger name/enabled matching is structural, not full semantic equivalence.

justifications.claim: Current bounded complement exists but materiality is unknown
Raw historical relation spans 42 screens with family_count 47

propagation.result: Retain P0 as historical scope only; require current manifest.
Use candidate set only for discovery; no totality claim.
Keep raw denominator separate from governed cohort.

alternative_supports: Current completeness needs an explicit governed universe predicate plus classification of complements and exclusions.

E.rationale: Frozen coverage is internally coherent and structurally resolvable, but current totality and governed cohort reproduction remain unverified.
potential_falsifiers: Authorized current universe manifest classifies all complements and exclusions.
Runtime edge evidence proves a material omitted current consumer.
Exact governed receipt predicate reproduces the intended historical cohort.

reversal_criteria.to_REPAIR_REQUIRED: A material in-scope current consumer/trigger is proven omitted.
reversal_criteria.to_NO_ACTION_SUPPORTED: Current universe and historical cohort are fully reconciled with no material omission.

negative_falsifiers: Do not equate frozen P0 completeness with current completeness.
Do not equate name-pattern candidates with runtime consumers.
Do not replace governed receipt denominator with raw 42-screen relation.
Do not infer trigger semantic equivalence from structural matching.
